content:
Creates a new custom folder for the current user.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE  custom role privilege. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
string
The name of the folder.
Note: Folder names can only contain letters, numbers, underscores,
hyphens, and whitespace.
